messages.author: c7fca810ace9a395
messages.subject: Rattle 2.3.0 crash on Ubuntu Gutsy
parts:
In case it helps anyone else I found these packages handy to have
installed, some more obvious than others:

libglade2-dev
libgtk2.0-dev
libcairo2-dev
r-cran-cairodevice
r-cran-rggobi
ggobi

Once they were installed the Rattle interface fired up. Now facing an
interesting error which may be because I am using gtk-2.10 instead of
the recommended gtk-2.80, possibly?

<code>
Error : .onLoad failed in 'loadNamespace' for 'cairoDevice'
Error in newPlot() : could not find function "asCairoDevice"
Error in if (which == 1) stop("cannot shut down device 1 (the null
device)") :
missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning messages:
1: NAs introduced by coercion in: as.integer.default(sub("Rattle: Plot
", "", ttl))
2: NAs introduced by coercion in: as.integer.default(sub("Rattle: Plot
", "", ttl))
*** stack smashing detected ***: /usr/lib/R/bin/exec/R terminated
Aborted (core dumped)
</code>

The error occurred after loading the Cats library dataset and
attempting to explore a Heirarchical Correlation.

Interestingly R Library datasets load but trying to open a csv dataset
using the current R setup gives this error:

<code>
> Error in if (target %in% ident) target <- NULL :
argument is of length zero
</code>

Any help would be greatly appreciate.

> missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
> In addition: Warning messages:
> 1: NAs introduced by coercion in: as.integer.default(sub("Rattle: Plot
> ", "", ttl))
> 2: NAs introduced by coercion in: as.integer.default(sub("Rattle: Plot
> ", "", ttl))
> *** stack smashing detected ***: /usr/lib/R/bin/exec/R terminated
> Aborted (core dumped)
> </code>
>
> The error occurred after loading the Cats library dataset and
> attempting to explore a Heirarchical Correlation.

You might get this error for any attempt to display a plot/graph if
Cairo is not working. In the settings menu you can turn the Cairo
device off and the plots should work.

> Interestingly R Library datasets load but trying to open a csv dataset
> using the current R setup gives this error:
>
> <code>
> > Error in if (target %in% ident) target <- NULL :
> argument is of length zero
> </code>

This was a transient error in Rattle. I wonder if the current version
from rattle.togaware.com fixes this for you?

Regards,
Graham

Hi Graham, thank you for your response. Version 2.3.2 does not solve
the CSV loading problem. I am trying to load a very simple CSV file
and get the following error:

rattle()
Error in sort.list(unique.default(x), na.last = TRUE) :
'x' must be atomic for 'sort.list'
Have you called 'sort' on a list?


Can no longer load Library datasets with this version. The same error
appears in the console and the Data pane displays NULL as the data
structure.

Oddly enough the same commands from the Rattle Logs work fine when
executed in the console:

crs$dataset <- read.csv("/usr/data/Play/five.csv", na.strings=c(".",
"NA", "", "?"))
